Pied-à-terre tax · FY2027 city values

NYC pied-à-terre tax checker

Is your condo, co-op or one- to three-family house over the line? Search by street address, ZIP code or BBL to see the city's value, the surcharge bracket and, for a co-op, an estimate from your shares.

First bills due January 1, 2027. Challenge the value with Form TC107 by March 1 (condos and co-ops) or March 15 (houses). Tax Law Article 30-C, §§ 1350–1356.

      For managing agents, boards and firms

      Building summaries and building-level data

      When the bills arrive, owners ask their managing agent, board or accountant the same questions. These answer them for a whole building at once, from public city records.

      Building summary

      One or two pages per building: units in each bracket and near each line, co-op share thresholds, recorded sales and the city's valuation, with a March 1 checklist. $149 a building, or $99 each for five or more.

      Building-level data

      A table of the 1,057 condo and co-op buildings with apartments over the $1 million line, refreshed when the tentative roll comes out in January. $1,500 for the year.

      API access

      Address and BBL lookups for intake or client tools, on a flat monthly fee. Write with what you need.
